simpleredstone.guide.page.1.title: Simple Redstone
simpleredstone.guide.page.1: The Double Piston - two blocks long, one block out for a weak signal and two for a strong one - and the Signal Dampener, a repeater that takes up to 3 off the signal.
simpleredstone.guide.page.2.title: Double Piston
simpleredstone.guide.page.2: A piston two blocks long (back cell and barrel) whose head comes out one or two blocks: a signal of 1 to 7 pushes one block, 8 to 15 two blocks.
simpleredstone.guide.page.3.title: Signal Dampener
simpleredstone.guide.page.3: A flat redstone part like the Repeater that takes 0 to 3 off the signal and passes it on one redstone tick later.
simpleredstone.guide.page.4.title: Creative tabs
simpleredstone.guide.page.4: Own tab with both parts and the guide. Both parts also sit behind the Repeater in Vanilla's redstone tab (config/simple-creative-tabs.properties).
simpleredstone.guide.page.5.title: Commands
simpleredstone.guide.page.6.title: Settings
simpleredstone.guide.page.6: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
quests.simpleredstone.start.title: Welcome to Simple Redstone
quests.simpleredstone.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simpleredstone.start.welcome.desc: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Redstone Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and redstone dust.
